topics.name: Whole numbers: counting, ordering, comparing, representing and place value
subtopics: Revision of Grade 5 work (integrated into the topics)
Order, compare and represent numbers to at least 9-digit numbers
Represent prime numbers to at least 100
Recognise the place value of digits in whole numbers to at least 9-digit numbers
Round off to the nearest 5, 10, 100 and 1 000

topics.name: Whole numbers: addition and subtraction
subtopics: Addition and subtraction of whole numbers with at least 5-digit and 6-digit numbers

Use any two techniques to perform and check calculations: estimation, columns, building up and breaking down, rounding off and compensating, number line, inverse operations, calculator (only to check answers)
Recognise and use the commutative, associative and distributive properties; 0 in terms of its additive property
Solve problems involving whole numbers in financial and measurement contexts

topics.name: Whole numbers: multiplication
subtopics: Multiplication of at least whole 4-digit by 3-digit numbers
Multiple operations on whole numbers with or without brackets
Use any two techniques: estimation, multiplying in columns, building up and breaking down, doubling and halving, inverse operations, calculator (only to check answers)
Multiples and factors of 2-digit and 3-digit numbers; prime factors of numbers to at least 100
Properties of whole numbers, including 1 in terms of its multiplicative property
Solve problems in financial and measurement contexts, ratio and rate

topics.name: Formal assessment task: Assignment
subtopics: Assignment on whole numbers: counting, ordering, comparing, representing and place value; addition and subtraction; multiplication (in class within 3 hours)

topics.name: Whole numbers: division
subtopics: Division of at least whole 4-digit by 3-digit numbers
Multiple operations on whole numbers with or without brackets
Use any two techniques: estimation, long division, building up and breaking down, inverse operations, calculator (only to check answers)
Recognise and use the distributive property; 1 in terms of its multiplicative property
Solve problems in financial and measurement contexts, ratio, rate, and grouping and equal sharing with remainders

topics.name: Revision
subtopics: Revision of Term 1 topics

topics.name: Formal assessment task: Test
subtopics: Test on all Term 1 topics

sba: Assignment: whole numbers (counting, ordering, comparing, representing and place value; addition and subtraction; multiplication), in class within 3 hours

topics.name: Number sentences
subtopics: Write number sentences to describe problem situations
Solve and complete number sentences by inspection and trial and improvement
Check solutions by substitution

topics.name: Numeric patterns
subtopics: Investigate and extend numeric patterns: sequences not limited to a constant difference or ratio, of learners' own creation, represented in tables
Describe observed relationships or rules in learners' own words
Determine input values, output values and rules using flow diagrams and tables
Determine equivalence of descriptions presented verbally, in a flow diagram, in a table and by a number sentence

topics.name: Geometric patterns
subtopics: Investigate and extend geometric patterns represented in physical or diagram form, not limited to a constant difference or ratio, and of learners' own creation
Describe observed relationships or rules in learners' own words
Determine input values, output values and rules using flow diagrams and tables
Determine equivalence of descriptions presented verbally, in a flow diagram, in a table and by a number sentence

topics.name: Common fractions
subtopics: Compare and order common fractions, including tenths and hundredths
Addition and subtraction of common fractions in which one denominator is a multiple of another, and of mixed numbers
Fractions of whole numbers
Solve problems in contexts involving common fractions, including grouping and sharing
Find percentages of whole numbers
Recognise and use equivalent forms of common fractions with 1-digit or 2-digit denominators
Recognise equivalence between common fraction and percentage forms of the same number

topics.name: Decimal fractions
subtopics: Count forwards and backwards in decimal fractions to at least two decimal places
Compare and order decimal fractions and state the place value of digits to at least two decimal places
Addition and subtraction of decimal fractions of at least two decimal places
Multiply decimal fractions by 10 and 100
Solve problems in context involving decimal fractions
Recognise equivalence between common fraction, decimal fraction and percentage forms of the same number

topics.name: Revision
subtopics: Revision of Term 1 and 2 work

topics.name: Formal assessment task: Test
subtopics: Test on all Term 1 and 2 topics

sba: Investigation: on any ONE of the Term 2 topics, administered before teaching it

topics.name: Length
subtopics: Estimate and practically measure 2D shapes and 3D objects using rulers, metre sticks, tape measures and trundle wheels
Record, compare and order lengths in mm, cm, m and km
Solve problems in contexts involving length
Convert between mm, cm, m and km, including common fraction and decimal fraction forms to 2 decimal places

topics.name: Properties of 2D shapes
subtopics: Regular and irregular polygons: triangles, squares, rectangles, parallelograms, other quadrilaterals, pentagons, hexagons, heptagons, octagons
Similarities and differences between rectangles and parallelograms
Describe, sort and compare 2D shapes in terms of number of sides, length of sides and size of angles
Recognise and name acute, right, obtuse, straight, reflex angles and revolutions in 2D shapes
Draw 2D shapes on grid paper; draw circles and patterns in and with circles using a pair of compasses

topics.name: Symmetry
subtopics: Recognise, draw and describe lines of symmetry in 2D shapes

topics.name: Transformations
subtopics: Make composite 2D shapes, including shapes with line symmetry, by rotation, translation or reflection
Make tessellated patterns, including some with line symmetry, by rotation, translation or reflection
Describe patterns in nature, modern everyday life and our cultural heritage referring to lines, 2D shapes, 3D objects, symmetry, rotations, reflections and translations
Draw enlargements and reductions of 2D shapes (triangles, quadrilaterals) to compare size and shape

topics.name: Properties of 3D objects
subtopics: Recognise, visualise and name 3D objects: rectangular prisms, cubes, tetrahedrons and pyramids
Similarities and differences between tetrahedrons and other pyramids
Describe, sort and compare 3D objects in terms of number and shape of faces, number of vertices and number of edges
Make 3D models using drinking straws, toothpicks and nets

topics.name: Area, perimeter and volume
subtopics: Measure perimeter using rulers or measuring tapes
Find areas of regular and irregular shapes by counting squares on grids; develop rules for the areas of squares and rectangles
Find volume/capacity by packing or filling; understand why the volume of a rectangular prism is length x width x height
Investigate the relationship between perimeter and area of rectangles and squares, and between surface area and volume of rectangular prisms

topics.name: Revision
subtopics: Revision of Term 3 topics

topics.name: Formal assessment task: Test
subtopics: Test on all Term 3 topics

sba: Project: covering a combination of topics from Terms 1 to 3, completed before the end of Term 3

topics.name: Mass
subtopics: Estimate and practically measure 3D objects using analogue and digital bathroom and kitchen scales, and balances
Record, compare and order mass in grams (g) and kilograms (kg)
Solve problems in contexts involving mass
Convert between grams and kilograms, including fraction and decimal forms (to 2 decimal places)

topics.name: Time
subtopics: Read, tell and write time in 12-hour and 24-hour formats on analogue and digital instruments; clocks, watches and stopwatches
Read calendars
Solve problems in contexts involving time
Read time zone maps and calculate time differences based on time zones
Calculate time intervals from seconds and minutes up to centuries, decades and years

topics.name: Capacity and volume
subtopics: Estimate and practically measure 3D objects using measuring spoons, cups and jugs
Record, compare and order capacity and volume in millilitres (ml), litres (l) and kilolitres (kl)
Solve problems in contexts involving capacity/volume
Convert between kilolitres, litres and millilitres, including fraction and decimal forms (to 2 decimal places)

topics.name: Data handling
subtopics: Collect data using tally marks, tables and simple yes/no questionnaires; order data from smallest to largest group
Draw pictographs with many-to-one representations, bar graphs and double bar graphs
Critically read and interpret data in words, pictographs, bar graphs, double bar graphs and pie charts
Analyse data by answering questions on data categories (including intervals), sources and contexts, and central tendencies (mode and median)
Summarise data verbally and in short written paragraphs, drawing conclusions and making predictions

topics.name: Use all four basic operations to solve problems in context
subtopics: Solve problems involving whole numbers and fractions in financial and measurement contexts
Fractions, including grouping and equal sharing
Compare two or more quantities of the same kind (ratio) and two quantities of different kinds (rate)
